title: The Last Row of the Mat

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager weaves the last row of a new sleeping mat.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) weaves the last row of a new sleeping mat. The finished mat is spread out, and (name1) lies down on it at once.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) weaves the last row of a new sleeping mat. (name1) notices one crooked row and decides it gives the mat character.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) weaves the last row of a new sleeping mat. A child asks to be the first to sit on it, and (name1) agrees.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) weaves the last row of a new sleeping mat. The smell of fresh fibers fills the hut that night.
